scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run deploy:code && npm run deploy:infra
scripts.deploy:code: rm -rf /tmp/lambda-build && mkdir /tmp/lambda-build && cp -r dist /tmp/lambda-build/ && cp package.json .npmrc /tmp/lambda-build/ && cd /tmp/lambda-build && npm install --omit=dev --no-package-lock && cd - && rm -f /tmp/photovault.zip && cd /tmp/lambda-build && zip -r /tmp/photovault.zip dist node_modules && cd - && AWS_PROFILE=photovault-akhil-app-user aws lambda update-function-code --function-name photovault-api --zip-file fileb:///tmp/photovault.zip --region us-east-1 && rm -rf /tmp/lambda-build /tmp/photovault.zip
scripts.deploy:infra: AWS_PROFILE=photovault-akhil-app-user aws cloudformation deploy --stack-name photovault-sam --template-file template-full.yaml --capabilities CAPABILITY_IAM --region us-east-1 --no-fail-on-empty-changeset
